# Wick & Hollow: how the shop runs

Wick & Hollow sells hand-poured candles from a spare room. Customers order on the website, and the website adds a new row to `orders.csv` each morning.

- I pack and post on Tuesdays and Fridays.
- Each order goes out as one parcel, to the address in the order.
- Gift requests (wrapping, a card message, a different address) arrive by email one at a time, and I sort them out by hand. It takes too long.
- Postage is free over £30.
